nodes.name: Weekdays 09:00 Chicago
nodes.notes: Cron runs in GENERIC_TIMEZONE (UTC). 14:00 UTC = 09:00 CDT / 08:00 CST.

nodes.name: Run on demand
nodes.notes: Lets the CLI (n8n execute --id=...) or another workflow trigger a reconciliation run now.

nodes.name: Fetch overdue invoices
nodes.notes: Full response + never error: downstream nodes branch on statusCode.

nodes.name: Delinquency alert received
nodes.notes: Signed with X-NexusFlow-Timestamp / X-NexusFlow-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of '<ts>.<raw body>').

nodes.name: Get account summary & draft notice
nodes.notes: Full response + never error: downstream nodes branch on statusCode.

nodes.name: Log action in NexusFlow
nodes.notes: Full response + never error: downstream nodes branch on statusCode.

meta.description: Weekdays 14:00 UTC (09:00 America/Chicago in CDT) polls overdue invoices, or receives a signed delinquency alert. Each invoice goes to FastAPI for the account summary and a collection-notice DRAFT (never sent), and the action is logged via the callback endpoint.
